args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim carriage returns (`\r`) from lines when splitting input in parseStatement, or check for both `""` and `"\r"` so that trailing empty lines with CRLF line endings are correctly popped before row parsing.
args.title: Fix trailing empty line parsing for CRLF line endings in parseStatement

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parser fails to pop trailing empty lines when files use CRLF (`\r\n`) line endings because the last line retains a carriage return (`\r`), leading to a 'Malformed row' assertShape error.
